title: Chocolate & Cream Layers
description: Two cozy autumn looks anchored by chocolate brown: look one pairs a cream half-zip knit and lace bra over a white ruffle mini skirt with over-the-knee brown boots and gold accessories for a playful feminine edge; look two swaps in a fitted brown boat-neck top and faux-fur jacket over black leggings with a black knee boot, plaid scarf, and dark glasses for a sleek moody city outfit.
occasion: weekend city walk, autumn brunch, coffee run
